bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220 Released - New features enhance settings management and multi-file sharing.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26120 Launched - Beta Channel introduces improved settings and file sharing capabilities.
Copilot on Windows Enhancements - New connectors enable seamless integration with personal services like **OneDrive** and **Google Drive**.
Microsoft Azure Unveils AI Supercluster - First large-scale cluster with **NVIDIA** GPUs accelerates **OpenAI** workloads.
Microsoft Expands Cloud Infrastructure in Asia - New datacenter regions enhance AI capabilities across the continent.
Microsoft Ignite 2025 Security Focus - Sessions designed to enhance security strategies for professionals.
Microsoft Teams Security Enhancements - New guidance to protect against threats targeting collaboration tools.
New Microsoft Secure Future Initiative - Expanded guidance to strengthen security practices across organizations.
Windows ML Overview Released - New capabilities for running AI models locally on Windows PCs.
AI Toolkit for Visual Studio Code Launched - Streamlined development for generative AI applications.
